title: The Broken Passage
author: Yara Underhill
blurb: Juniper Okafor, a storm chaser who owes money to dangerous optimists, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then a government survey team vanishes, leaving gear and no tracks — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
